purpose: Diagnose the joint source-receiver rigid-translation sensitivity of the PFFDTD dense sub-band worsening pattern: re-execute the three canonical PFFDTD legs under the frozen solver contract with BOTH comms stencils moved by the same frozen whole-cell offset on each level's unchanged cartesian grid — the pair separation vector held fixed — re-derive the finite-record transfers on the unchanged 34-frequency dense grid under the same metric/pairs/thresholds, and record whether the 10->12 worsening vector survives a translation that preserves the pair's relative geometry. Predeclared verbatim by docs/R130D_GENERAL3D_SOURCE_POSITION_SENSITIVITY_RESULT_2026-10-03.md as the next pre-fixed numerical experiment: separates relative-geometry binding from absolute-modal-position binding, which neither single-endpoint axis (receiver-position REV39-R130D5, source-position REV39-R130D6) could distinguish.

run76_record_binding.binding_rule: the canonical cell evaluates the same persisted pressure/source records as authoritative run #76; a run that re-executes the pinned PFFDTD contract binds to those records by comparing the semantic sha256 of the recombined pressure trace and the unit discrete volume-velocity impulse source trace at every predeclared PPW level; only the canonical cell is bound to run-76 records, every joint-moved cell is a re-executed variant leg with its own recorded trace digests
run76_record_binding.on_nonidentical: the computed sweep values are still emitted, but evaluation_state becomes NOT_EVALUATED_RECORD_BINDING_MISMATCH and the frozen classification is withheld so the result cannot be read as the run-76 experiment

joint_translation_sensitivity.axis: joint source-receiver rigid-translation sensitivity of the dense sub-band worsening: move BOTH the source comms stencil (in_ixyz) and the receiver comms stencil (out_ixyz) by the same frozen whole-cell offset vector on each level's own cartesian grid — the source-receiver pair separation vector held exactly fixed — and re-execute the pinned SimEngine on byte-copied sim asset sets; the injected signal rows in_sigs and the readout weight row out_alpha, geometry, cartesian grid, boundary/staircase representation, materials, time sampling, duration, and the scored contract are unchanged

offset_lattice_convention.units: whole grid cells on the level's own uniform cartesian grid; an offset (kx,ky,kz) moves BOTH the source and the receiver exact positions by (kx*h, ky*h, kz*h) at that level's grid spacing h
offset_lattice_convention.moved_position_rule: the moved stencils are the canonical eight-node in_ixyz and out_ixyz sets each rigidly translated by the same offset vector; the canonical per-node injected-signal rows in_sigs (and hence the trilinear source weight row they encode) and the canonical readout weight row out_alpha are unchanged — a pure pair translation with no stencil-weight confound and no separation change
offset_lattice_convention.pair_separation_invariant: the construction invariant of the axis: moved_source_position_m - moved_receiver_position_m must equal canonical_source_position_m - canonical_receiver_position_m exactly (both stencils translate by the same vector); the frozen separation vector is (-1.0, 0.0, 0.0) m
offset_lattice_convention.fail_closed_gates: a moved cell is only executable iff every moved in_ixyz node AND every moved out_ixyz node is inside the grid, no moved node sits on an outer absorbing-layer plane (any axis index 0 or N-1), and every moved node is air-connected under the frozen six-neighbor cartesian BFS of the canonical boundary representation; a cell that fails any gate blocks the diagnostic as fail-closed (ValidationBlocked)
offset_lattice_convention.determinism: the offset lattice is declared in whole cells and applied identically to both stencils at every level; no fractional-cell offsets, no in_sigs/out_alpha reweighting, no unequal source-vs-receiver offsets (which would change the pair separation under test), and no boundary/grid/constants change is permitted

joint_offsets.rule: the unchanged canonical source+receiver stencils: the control cell that reproduces the canonical dense worsening vector and binds the run-76 records
pair moved one cell along -x (~0.43 m at PPW 8), separation unchanged
pair moved one cell along +x, separation unchanged
pair moved two cells along -x, separation unchanged
pair moved two cells along +x, separation unchanged
pair moved one cell along -y, lateral, separation unchanged
pair moved one cell along +y toward the sloped ceiling side, separation unchanged
pair moved two cells along -y, lateral, separation unchanged
pair moved two cells along +y toward the sloped ceiling side, separation unchanged
pair moved one cell along -z toward the floor, separation unchanged
pair moved one cell along +z toward the sloped ceiling, separation unchanged
pair moved two cells along -z toward the floor, separation unchanged
pair moved two cells along +z toward the sloped ceiling, separation unchanged

execution.solver_executions: the three canonical binding legs plus one re-executed variant leg per non-control cell per level on a byte-copied sim asset set (vox_out.h5, comms_out.h5, sim_consts.h5, sim_mats.h5) with the comms in_ixyz AND out_ixyz node sets both replaced by the frozen moved stencils; in_sigs, out_alpha, Ns, Nr and Nt are unchanged
execution.canonical_cell_rule: reuse the canonical leg outputs that bind run76_record_binding
execution.contract_invariant: every variant leg must preserve the frozen contract byte-identically except the two moved node sets: vox static authority (xv/yv/zv/h/Nx/Ny/Nz), sim consts, sim mats, in_sigs, out_alpha, Ns, Nr and Nt are sha256-verified identical to the canonical leg, and the rewritten in_ixyz and out_ixyz must equal the frozen moved stencils exactly
execution.source_injection_rule: the variant run injects the unchanged canonical in_sigs rows at the moved source nodes — the same trilinear source weight row applied at the moved position — and the variant pressure record is recombined from the re-executed u_out at the moved out_ixyz nodes with the unchanged canonical out_alpha row, then converted with the frozen p=rho*d(phi)/dt second-order convention and analyzed against the unchanged unit-impulse source spectrum on the dense grid

rejected_axes.reason: a non-integer offset changes the trilinear weight rows encoded in in_sigs and out_alpha and confounds translation with the already-executed stencil-weight axis; only whole-cell moves keep both weight rows identical across variants

rejected_axes.axis: meter-fixed offsets instead of whole-cell offsets
rejected_axes.reason: a meter-fixed offset lands on different fractional cell coordinates at different PPW levels and changes the weight rows per level; whole-cell offsets preserve the canonical stencil shapes on every level's own grid

rejected_axes.axis: unequal source-vs-receiver offsets or single-endpoint moves
rejected_axes.reason: moving only one stencil changes the pair separation vector — that is exactly the receiver-position (REV39-R130D5) and source-position (REV39-R130D6) axes already executed; this axis holds the separation fixed so only the pair's absolute position changes

rejected_axes.axis: in_sigs reweighting or out_alpha reweighting / stencil-shape changes at the moved nodes
rejected_axes.reason: the moved stencils keep the canonical weight rows; weight perturbations were already measured by the parent stencil-sensitivity axis

rejected_axes.axis: multi-source injection or source/receiver count changes
rejected_axes.reason: Ns and Nr stay at the canonical stencil shapes; a different injection/readout topology would change the observable under test

rejected_axes.axis: boundary, material, time-sampling or solver-constant changes
rejected_axes.reason: those axes are covered by the voxel-staircase and time-gate diagnostics; this axis only translates the measurement pair on the unchanged executed grid

evaluation.frequency_grid_ref: the dense_frequency_neighborhood band grid of the bound parent dense diagnostic plan (34 frequencies, 36.0-44.0/76.0-84.0 Hz at 0.5 Hz)
evaluation.worsening_rule: worsening at frequency f iff d_10_12(f) > d_8_10(f); the complete predeclared grid is evaluated for every cell with no post-result selection

per_cell_classification.rule: the dense worsening-count thresholds of the bound parent dense diagnostic plan applied to each cell independently

evaluation.carries_worsening_rule: a moved cell carries the worsening iff its worsening count exceeds localized_max_count, i.e. its per-cell dense classification is MIXED or PERSISTS rather than LOCALIZED
evaluation.pattern_metric: per-cell 34-frequency worsening vector compared to the canonical cell's vector; hamming_distance = count of frequencies whose worsening bit differs

classification.rule: evaluate in order: (1) relative_geometry_invariant iff every evaluated non-control cell reproduces the canonical worsening vector exactly — the vector survives a rigid pair translation intact, so the worsening is bound to the pair's relative geometry alone; (2) absolute_position_bound iff at least one evaluated non-control cell does not carry the worsening (its per-cell dense classification is localized) — the worsening dissolves under a translation that preserves the pair geometry, so it is bound to the pair's absolute position in the room's modal structure; (3) shifted iff no non-control cell is localized and at least one moved vector differs — every joint-translated pair still produces the worsening (the phenomenon survives translation, bound to the pair's relative geometry in existence) while its 34-bin distribution shifts (absolute-position dependence of the detail); otherwise mixed
